title: Bank payments coded to expense that match an open bill, recoded against the bill
prompt: Find bank payments in the last closed month coded straight to expense that match an open bill in AP, and propose recoding them against the bill.

setup.q: Which bank accounts are reconciled every month?

inputs.name: Open bills and the AP aging
Bank transactions coded to expense for the month

steps: pull the open bills and the month's bank outflows from bankAccountsInScope coded to an expense account, and the journal match candidates Dime offers for each
match a payment to a bill when the vendor is the same, the amount agrees to the cent and the dates are within 30 days; anything looser is listed, not proposed
propose the recode (tier A): apply the bank payment to the bill so the expense is not counted twice
write the workbook with the bank row and the bill on every exception

done.text: Every exception row cites the bank transaction id and the bill id
bills-paid-direct.xlsx opens with Exceptions first (count and total on the first rows), a Tie-out block whose Difference is 0.00, and no internal plumbing words
Every proposal names a route the desk may call and carries no unbalanced entry
Only exact matches (same vendor, amount to the cent, within 30 days) are proposed; near matches are listed for a person; a closed period turns the recode into a question

tierRules.when: same vendor, amount agrees to the cent, bank date within 30 days of the bill date
